title: RPG MMV Windows Installers keep ruining save game ability

posts.author: S3zertii
posts.body:
Hi Everyone!!
This refers to installers for windows
Whenever I create an installer for my RPG Maker MV game the game works PERFECTLY!
Except for the fact that if you try to save your game after it is installed to Windows you are blocked.
Tried Inno Installer and Advanced Installer and both have the same issue.
Any ideas?
Thanks!

posts.author: FrigidGaze
posts.body:
Hiya,
Where does the installer install to by default? Since it's possible it's installing somewhere where it might not have permissions to create additional files like saves, etc.
In most cases it's typically advised just to bundle the game in a .zip folder so users can extract it to a place of their choosing, and installers are viewed a bit more warily by a large amount of users these days.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Assuming those "installers" work anything like enigma virtual box, I'd think your save folder (which is located inside of your game's folder by default) can now no longer be accessed due to it being packed into a single .exe file.
In that case, you could use a plugin to change the place where the save file will be located.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
to addition to SGHarlekin, if its works similar to Enigma Virtual Box,
create a www folder next to the exe file, within the www folder, a save folder.
then run your game (if it boots directly), it should save and load as normal.
